parsed.name: Pfeiffer 真空泵（RS-485 串口）
parsed.description: Pfeiffer 的真空泵或其配套控制单元，可通过 RS-485 串行总线进行通信。该类设备常用于实验室真空系统中，用于接收设备消息并进行运行状态监测与远程通信。
parsed.description_en: A Pfeiffer vacuum pump or associated control unit that communicates over an RS-485 serial link. This type of device is used in laboratory vacuum systems to receive device messages and support operation monitoring and remote communication.

actions.description: 关闭与设备的 RS-485 串口通信连接。
actions.description_en: Close the RS-485 serial communication link to the device.

actions.description: 读取并解析设备发出的下一条消息。
actions.description_en: Read and decode the next message sent by the device.

actions.description: 从串口读取设备返回的下一行原始数据。
actions.description_en: Read the next raw line returned by the device from the serial interface.
